intro: Discover Gran Canaria, from the dunes of Maspalomas and beaches of Puerto Rico to the historic streets of Las Palmas, mountain villages and volcanic landscapes. Save your plans, memorable visits, photos and holiday spending on your device.

areas.name: Maspalomas & Meloneras
areas.description: Southern resort area with famous dunes, beaches, a lighthouse and seafront dining.

areas.name: Playa del Inglés
areas.description: Popular southern resort with a long beach, shops and nightlife.

areas.name: Puerto Rico
areas.description: Sunny southwest resort with a sheltered beach, marina and boat trips.

areas.name: Puerto de Mogán
areas.description: Picturesque harbour village with canals, cafés and a sandy beach.

areas.name: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria
areas.description: Island capital with Las Canteras beach and historic Vegueta.

areas.name: San Agustín
areas.description: Quieter coastal resort near Playa del Inglés.

areas.name: Agaete & Puerto de las Nieves
areas.description: Northwest coast with dramatic cliffs, natural pools and ferry port.

attractions.name: Dunas de Maspalomas
attractions.description: Protected sand-dune landscape; stay on marked permitted paths.

attractions.name: Roque Nublo
attractions.description: Iconic volcanic rock formation in the island interior; check access rules and any reservation requirements.

attractions.name: Vegueta, Las Palmas
attractions.description: Historic district with traditional architecture, museums and squares.

attractions.name: Palmitos Park
attractions.description: Wildlife and botanical attraction near Maspalomas; check animal welfare information, tickets and opening times.

attractions.name: Jardín Botánico Canario
attractions.description: Botanical garden near Las Palmas showcasing Canary Islands plants.

attractions.name: Barranco de Guayadeque
attractions.description: Scenic ravine with caves and viewpoints; drive and walk with care.

transport.name: Walking
transport.description: Promenades are walkable; inland routes can be steep and exposed to sun.

transport.name: Global buses
transport.description: Intercity bus network across Gran Canaria; check current routes and timetables.

transport.name: Guaguas Municipales
transport.description: City buses within Las Palmas; check fares and stops.

transport.name: Car hire
transport.description: Useful for inland villages and viewpoints; mountain roads can be narrow and winding.

transport.name: Taxis
transport.description: Licensed taxis operate in resorts and towns; confirm fares or meter before travelling.

transport.name: Airport connections
transport.description: Gran Canaria Airport (LPA) has bus, taxi and car-hire connections; check current services.

useful.name: Emergency services
useful.description: Call 112 in an emergency in Spain.

useful.name: Sun and heat
useful.description: Use sun protection and carry water, particularly around dunes and inland walks.

useful.name: Sea safety
useful.description: Follow lifeguard advice and beach flags; currents and waves can be strong.

useful.name: Currency
useful.description: Euro (€); check bank fees and exchange rates.

useful.name: Travel documents
useful.description: Check UK government travel advice for Spain and your insurance.

useful.name: Language
useful.description: Spanish is the official language; English is widely spoken in major resorts.

useful.name: Time zone
useful.description: Gran Canaria uses the same local time as the UK for most of the year.

beaches.name: Playa de Maspalomas
beaches.description: Wide beach by the protected dunes; check swimming flags.

beaches.name: Playa del Inglés
beaches.description: Long sandy beach with resort facilities and promenades.

beaches.name: Playa de Amadores
beaches.description: Sheltered southwest bay with pale sand and cafés.

beaches.name: Playa de Puerto Rico
beaches.description: Popular family-friendly resort beach near the marina.

beaches.name: Playa de Las Canteras
beaches.description: Urban beach in Las Palmas with a long promenade.

beaches.name: Playa de Mogán
beaches.description: Small sandy beach beside Puerto de Mogán harbour.

markets.name: Puerto de Mogán market
markets.description: Popular market area; verify days and stalls locally.

markets.name: San Mateo market
markets.description: Inland town known for regional produce and weekend market atmosphere.

markets.name: Vegueta market area
markets.description: Explore food shops and market stalls in historic Las Palmas.

markets.name: Maspalomas shopping
markets.description: Browse shopping centres and resort shops; verify opening hours.

nightlife.name: Playa del Inglés
nightlife.description: Bars, entertainment and clubs, especially around Yumbo Centre.

nightlife.name: Meloneras
nightlife.description: Seafront restaurants and relaxed evening venues.

nightlife.name: Puerto Rico
nightlife.description: Resort bars, live entertainment and waterfront dining.

nightlife.name: Las Palmas
nightlife.description: City restaurants, music venues and evening walks near Las Canteras.

family.name: Aqualand Maspalomas
family.description: Water park; check height restrictions, tickets and opening hours.

family.name: Poema del Mar Aquarium
family.description: Aquarium in Las Palmas; check opening times and prices.

family.name: Puerto de Mogán
family.description: Harbour stroll, beach time and family-friendly cafés.

family.name: Las Canteras beach day
family.description: Promenade, beach activities and places to eat; supervise children in the sea.

family.name: Dolphin-watching excursions
family.description: Choose responsible operators and remember wildlife sightings are not guaranteed.

dining.name: Puerto de Mogán harbour
dining.description: Harbourfront restaurants serving seafood and Canarian dishes.

dining.name: Las Palmas / Vegueta
dining.description: Explore tapas, cafés and local cuisine.

dining.name: Puerto Rico marina
dining.description: Casual restaurants and cafés near the waterfront.

dining.name: Try local dishes
dining.description: Look for papas arrugadas with mojo sauce, gofio and fresh fish.

daytrips.name: Roque Nublo & Tejeda
daytrips.description: Mountain scenery and village stops; check trail access and driving conditions.

daytrips.name: Las Palmas & Vegueta
daytrips.description: Historic centre, shops and Las Canteras beach.

daytrips.name: Puerto de Mogán
daytrips.description: Harbour, cafés and beach; accessible by road or selected boat services.

daytrips.name: Agaete & Puerto de las Nieves
daytrips.description: Northwest coastal scenery and natural pools; check sea conditions.

daytrips.name: Teror & Arucas
daytrips.description: Traditional towns, architecture and local food.

daytrips.name: Guayadeque ravine
daytrips.description: Cave dwellings, landscapes and rural dining; check access.
